VESSEL IS CURRENTLY SITTING IN AN APPROX 6' DEPTH; THE INCOMING TIDE WILL REACH APPROX 8' AND OIL WILL SPREAD FURTHER. VESSEL IS CURRENTLY ATTACHED TO A RESIDENTIAL DOCK AND IS NOT BOOMED OFF
